In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the structure of the SC lipid model membrane with FFA and the structure of the PA-containing membrane are close to each other and do not change significantly with the change in the membrane composition.
FFA in SC membrane composition does not influence the membrane structure, but rather affects the water content of the SC model membrane.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SC model membranes with FFA and with PA are similar in their organization and behavior, and that cholesterol sulfate is an important membrane component.

the SC model membrane based on short chain ceramide 6 and containing a realistic mixture of FFA has a similar structure to that of the earlier studied model membrane based on PA, but is more sensitive to changes in the composition of the model system.
FFA is an integral part of SC membranes, and its presence in SC membranes is important for understanding the structure of the SC barrier.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the composition of FFA does not influence the structure of SC model membranes.
the SC model membranes with FFA and cholesterol have a structure and behavior similar to the model membranes containing PA.
the structure of the SC model membrane with FFA does not depend on the FFA composition.
